name: Albino Cult Host
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one dedicated static full-body 2D game character cutout for Alien Tantalus Frontier.
Input image 1 is the existing Cult Host identity and rendering-style reference only, NOT an output grid. Create ONE new standing character pose, not a sprite sheet.
Subject: Albino Cult Host, an original project systemic variant (not a canon-exact design). Preserve the reference's adult bald human, two ordinary arms, two ordinary legs, worn button-front work shirt with rolled sleeves, full trousers, heavy boots, and round respirator/filter hanging on chest straps. Slightly hunched wary neutral standing stance, head and body facing RIGHT, empty hands relaxed. Keep all clothing and recognizable human anatomy; no alien limbs.
Variant lock: Original systemic pale-material variant of the exact existing base anatomy and equipment: warm ivory, ash-gray and restrained pink-beige material accents; preserve surface relief and readability. For humans this means pale field equipment, not a claim about ethnicity or a canonical faction uniform. No extra appendages, invented anatomy or new weapons.
Rendering: match the reference's detailed painted realistic 2D game sprite, textured workwear, readable silhouette, restrained directional highlights and dark contours, not cartoon/chibi.
Composition: ONE character completely visible from scalp to soles in a single frame, slightly elevated side/three-quarter game view facing right. At least 10% fully transparent padding on ALL sides. Feet on a consistent imaginary ground line. Genuine transparent RGBA background with no ground plane, no shadow blob.
Avoid: grid, panels, duplicate figures, text, logo, watermark, weapons, nudity, wounds, blood, gore, detached parts, cropped feet/head, scenery, painted checkerboard. No image postprocessing will be used.

reference.visualNotes: Viewed action sheet: adult bald clothed man, rolled-sleeve tan work shirt, brown trousers/boots, chest-hanging round respirator; ordinary two-arm/two-leg anatomy, hunched right-facing stance. Source sheet has multiple poses; generated output requests a single neutral figure.

review.notes: Single clothed adult human, two arms/two legs, round chest respirator, boots and right-facing hunched pose match base. Pale cloth equipment variant. Full body intact; requested 10% top/bottom padding not achieved (actual margins recorded), no clipping.
